dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. dimensions.name: 02_count_py_green_except_the_record
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. I also ran python3 tools/count.py on the artifact tree directly: it reports exactly one problem, the named record problem ('release 0.9.9 has no record/custody-v0.9.9.json and no record/RECORD-GAP-v0.9.9.md saying why'), which is Instrument 2's file and required to be carried and named here; no stale/gap/other problems. Both bites (planted gap note, planted stale token) bit. NOTE on a PRIOR, not on this artifact: the packet's ground_truth claims test_02 is also RED at base; my own base measurement (clone of this job root at HEAD 2ad7dc2, bar bytes verified 11c7dc71…) gives FAILED (failures=1), test_00 red and test_02 green at base, matching the bar's own docstring (line 102-103). The bar is red at base under both readings, so the gate's polarity holds; the discrepancy is in the packet's PRIOR entry, not in the artifact and not in the frozen bar.

dimensions.name: 06_cadence_amendment_and_the_no_requirement_claim

dimensions.name: 07_contributing_names_v098_and_carries_no_token_count_py_reads
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. CONTRIBUTING.md no longer carries the bare 0.9.8 token (or any other non-release token count.py reads); the rewritten sentence still states the fact — the release before this one shipped without a record — and names where the note is kept (record/). The claim arm verified on a planted cut tree that a false sentence naming THIS release as shipping without a record is refused, while the honest rewrite clears both the bar and count.py. Deletion-of-sentence, deletion-of-paragraph and re-planted-token plants all bit.

dimensions.name: 08_readme_contributing_draft_note_are_consistent

The tree is cut (0.9.9 vs base 0.9.8), so the zero verdict applied: DRAFT-NOTE.md's hunk inventory lists only the seven editable documents (CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, DRAFT-NOTE, README, SPEC, the two examples) and measure_draft_note_claims_frozen returned zero frozen-path claims; README.md's **Status: v0.9.9, candidate.** agrees with SPEC.md; all required base phrases survive in README/CONTRIBUTING/DRAFT-NOTE. The inventory-line, prose-claim and bump-only-note plants all bit, and the cleared-note fix was accepted.

dimensions.name: 09_every_current_document_is_clean
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run.
